text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Oooh! They're selling colorful juice!
Turbo wants to drink that, drink it now!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Nuwa! What a dignified statue over there!
I cannot let myself be outdone! Bakushin!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Hey, don't just dash off on your own!!
That's the completely wrong wayyyy!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: While walking in front of the station, I spotted some familiar faces. ...They seemed rather busy with something.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Ngh!!
Traaaiiiner~~!! Perfect timing...!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: We were talking about heading out together with a few people today, but—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Ikuno and Flower's schedules suddenly clashed, so things ended up like this...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: ...Wait, where did those kids go?!
choice_data_list: I'm sure it was over there...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Riding that momentum, I ended up joining Mejiro Palmer and the others.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Ooh, a train is running! But I am faster than any train! En garde!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Turbo is fast too! Turbo won't loseeee!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: H-Hey, don't run in the riverーーー!!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Oho, the zoo, is it?!
Well, this here Class Rep is even faster than a cheetah!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Turbo too! I'll beat a cheeeeetah!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Don't run in crowded plaaaaces!!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, there's a suspension bridge here!
I shall show you all that I can reach the other side
the fastest!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
No way, Turbo's number one~~!
I'm not letting you past me~~~~!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Waaah, no no no!!
I'm telling you, that's dangerouuuus!!!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
*wheeze*, *pant*...
What kind of stamina do those girls have...!?
Just how far are they planning to go...!?
choice_data_list: At this point, I might as well see it through to the very end...
Maybe we should decide on a destination for them.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Ahaha... Well, figures that'd happen.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Heeeeeey!! Palmer!!
Over heeeeeere~~!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Comiiiing... On my wayyy...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so—
wandering, wandering, continuing to wander...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Nuwa, this is...!!
Palmer-san!! Palmer-san!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Okaaay, what is it this time—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: —Wah.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Look! A vibrant array of flowers is blooming
just as magnificently as the cherry blossoms!!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Oooohhh, it's so colorful--!!
Super duper colorful--!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, it's so beautiful...!
To think we could actually make it to a place like this...!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Hehehe, now that we've come to such a lovely place,
there's only one thing to do!
And that is—

text_block_list.name: Both
text_block_list.text:
—Bakushin, indeed!!
—Bakushin, it is!!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Chowaah, that was MY lineーーー!!!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The three Umamusume ran around the flowers for a while.
Seeing such a heartwarming sight brought warmth to my chest.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
I see, that makes sense.
Do you have any recommended spots?
choice_data_list: How about somewhere you want to go?
How about somewhere you want to go?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
The place I want to go...
—Ah.

text_block_list.name: Both
text_block_list.text: Whoaaaaaaa!!!!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
What a magnificent view...!! Its sheer
grandeur makes my heart Bakushin with excitement!!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
That building over there is so sparkly--!!
And that one's all spiky--!!
What even are those--!?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Ahaha, I'm glad you're happy with it!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Look, you can see how the view goes on forever, right?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
I ran a lot today,
but there are still plenty of places left for me to run!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: When you think about it like that, doesn't it sound super fun?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Twin Turbo and Sakura Bakushin O nodded to
each other. The endless blue sky stretching above them
was full of hope and a bright future.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Yes, yes, I understand completely!!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
I am so deeply moved, I feel like Bakushin-ing right now!
All the way beyond the horizon!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Whoa now...
Well, that changes things quite a bit~...
